title: 84 octave scale transformation: physical origin open
description: The user declares 7 nodes times 12 doublings. f_N=f0*2^84 is algebraically defined; no independent mechanism requiring that exponent was located in the inspected repository. H_OCTAVE_84 remains open.
assumptions: f0=7.834 Hz is an input choice, not a universal constant
Each step means an octave doubling, not a 12-TET semitone
confusion_guard: Scale transformation does not establish scale invariance, RG flow, an eigenmode ladder or a physical energy source.
falsification_conditions: A timestamped independent mechanism requires another exponent or step ratio.

evidence.notes: Known target values were supplied before this freeze; no claim of prospective validation.
